lines.en: label mall5:
scene mall1
Once again, I decide to kill some time at the mall.
lines.zh: 我又一次决定来商场消磨时间。

lines.en: This time, however, it doesn’t look like Chika is on her normal bench.
lines.zh: 不过这一次，Chika 好像没有坐在她平时那张长椅上。

lines.en: I suppose my streak of perfect convenience comes to an end today as I must now scan the halls of this brightly colored, obnoxiously loud building in order to find her.
lines.zh: 看来我今天那一路顺风顺水的好运要走到头了——现在我得把这栋颜色鲜艳、吵得要命的建筑里的大厅扫一遍，才能找到她。

lines.en: But it is what it is, I guess.
lines.zh: 不过事已至此，我想也没办法。

lines.en: I was honestly beginning to question whether or not she even had a job or if she was just pretending to have one to impress me.
lines.zh: 说实话，我都开始怀疑她到底有没有工作，还是只是装出有工作的样子来让我刮目相看。

lines.en: Granted, she could {i}actually{/i} be working right now, but...I don't know.
lines.zh: 当然，她{i}现在{/i}可能真的在上班，不过……我不知道。

lines.en: I won't believe it until I see it.
lines.zh: 不亲眼看到我是不会信的。

lines.en: scene mall2
I walk around the mall for a good ten minutes or so without any sign of Chika, meaning she’s either off today or on the clock right now.
lines.zh: 我在商场里转了足有十分钟，一点 Chika 的影子都没有，也就是说她今天要么休息，要么正在上班。

lines.en: If I remember correctly, I think she said she worked at some high-end boutique or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 如果我没记错的话，她好像说过自己在某家高级精品店之类的地方工作。

lines.en: The only problem is that I have no idea what counts as {i}high-end,{/i} so I don't even have a place to start.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，我根本不知道什么才算{i}高级{/i}，所以连个起点都没有。

lines.en: Not knowing what else to do, I check out a nearby directory and pinpoint the store with the fanciest name I can find before beginning my search there...
lines.zh: 不知道还能怎么办，我去查了旁边的导览图，挑了个名字听起来最花哨的店，从那儿开始找起……

lines.en: scene black
scene mallfive1
: Hey, welcome-
lines.zh: : 嘿，欢迎-

lines.en: : Woah! Sensei! I had no idea you were coming in today!
lines.zh: : 哇！Sensei！我完全不知道你今天会来！

lines.en: scene mallfive2
Chika excitedly throws a handbag onto a display shelf and hurries over to me.
lines.zh: Chika 兴奋地把一只手提包甩到陈列架上，急急忙忙朝我跑过来。

lines.en: : Hey! What are you doing here? Shopping on your day off?
lines.zh: : 嘿！你来这儿干嘛？休息日来逛街？

lines.en: : We're actually having a sale on men's clothing right now, so instead of everything costing like, 90%% of your annual salary, it's probably closer to, like...70%%.
lines.zh: : 我们现在男装正好在打折，所以不是每件都要花掉你年薪的 90%%，大概就，嗯……70%% 吧。

lines.en: : Wow, you really weren’t kidding when you said ‘high-end’ were you?
lines.zh: : 哇，你说「高级」的时候还真没开玩笑啊？

lines.en: scene mallfive3
: Hahahah~ Oh, come on! You know I’m just messing around!! There's no way we'd charge more than 60%% of your annual salary, tops.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈~ 哎呀，别这样！你知道我开玩笑的！！我们最多也不可能收你年薪的 60%% 以上啊。

lines.en: : You know, I think I'll stick to my one outfit.
lines.zh: : 我想我还是继续穿我那一身吧。

lines.en: scene mallfive4
: I get it, no worries. I guess everything here {i}is{/i} still kind of expensive when you compare it to...literally everywhere else.
lines.zh: : 我懂，没关系。跟……其他任何地方比起来，这里的东西{i}确实{/i}还是挺贵的。

lines.en: scene mallfive4r
: But you’re like, a big shot teacher, right? I’m sure you’ve got some extra cash to spare.
lines.zh: : 可你不是那种大人物老师吗？肯定有闲钱吧。

lines.en: : I mean...I wouldn't say I'm {i}poor{/i} by any means, but I'm not really sitting on a mountain of cash either.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我也不会说自己{i}穷{/i}，但我也没坐在一座钱堆上。

lines.en: : Besides, I don’t really think any of this stuff would suit me.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得这些东西也不太适合我。

lines.en: scene mallfive5
: Hey, don’t say that! I think you’d look really handsome in some of our stuff.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别这么说！我觉得你穿我们有些衣服会特别帅。

lines.en: : I can help you pick some stuff out, if you want. I'm pretty good at that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 你要是愿意，我可以帮你挑挑。我挺擅长这种事的。

lines.en: : Maybe some other time. I sort of just dropped by to see how you were doing today.
lines.zh: : 下次吧。我大概就是顺路来看看你今天过得怎么样。

lines.en: scene mallfive6
: Oh my God! Did you really come all the way over here just to see me?! That’s like, totally adorable!
lines.zh: : 天哪！你真的是特地跑来看我的吗？！这也太可爱了吧！

lines.en: : How come? Isn’t there someone like, closer to your age you’d rather spend your time with?
lines.zh: : 为什么啊？不是有跟你年纪更相近的人更想一起待着吗？

lines.en: : Someone I’d rather hang out with than Chika Chosokabe? Unlikely.
lines.zh: : 比 Chika Chosokabe 更想一起待着的人？不太可能。

lines.en: scene mallfive7
: Oh, stop it. I don't believe that for even a second.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，行了。我一个字都不信。

lines.en: : There’s gotta be {i}someone{/i} out there you’ve got, like...more in common with or whatever.
lines.zh: : 肯定{i}有{/i}什么人，跟你……更有共同语言什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t think we need to have anything in common to enjoy being around each other.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，就算没有共同点，也不妨碍我们相处得开心。

lines.en: : If you enjoy being around me, I mean.
lines.zh: : 如果你跟我待在一起觉得开心的话。

lines.en: scene mallfive2
: Oh my God, of course I like being around you! Haven’t you noticed that I’ve been skipping class waaaaay less often lately?
lines.zh: : 天哪，我当然喜欢跟你待在一起！你没发现我最近翘课的次数少{i}了好多{/i}吗？

lines.en: : My grades have been getting a little better-ish, too!
lines.zh: : 我的成绩也稍微好了那么一点——大概吧！

lines.en: : I mean, I’m sure that’s also thanks to you barely giving us any work, but yeah. I like you.
lines.zh: : 我猜这也多亏了你几乎不给我们布置作业，不过，对。我喜欢你。

lines.en: scene mallfive8
: Oh! Wait! No! Not like that! That...That probably sounded weird, didn't it? Like...I like you as a {i}teacher.{/i} Or a...friend. Or something.
lines.zh: : 啊！等等！不是！不是那种意思！那……那听起来大概很怪吧？就是……我是作为{i}老师{/i}喜欢你。或者……朋友。之类的。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Chika. I like you too.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Chika。我也喜欢你。

lines.en: scene mallfive6
: I...okay! Yeah!
lines.zh: : 我……好吧！嗯！

lines.en: : We...like each other! Which is awesome!
lines.zh: : 我们……互相喜欢！这超棒的！

lines.en: : Well, uhh...just so you know, you can come hang out here whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 嗯，呃……先说好，你想什么时候来找我都可以。

lines.en: : I work most of my shifts alone, so as long as my boss isn’t here and it’s not super busy, I'd love to see you.
lines.zh: : 我大部分班次都是一个人看店，所以只要我老板不在、店里又不忙，我很乐意见到你。

lines.en: scene mallfive9
: And who knows? Maybe I’ll even let you judge some of the stuff I try on but can’t afford!
lines.zh: : 而且谁知道呢？说不定我还会让你评价一下我试穿但买不起的衣服呢！

lines.en: : Well, I'm not really known for my fashion sense, but I’d love seeing you dress up.
lines.zh: : 我的时尚品味不算出名，但我很乐意看你打扮。

lines.en: : You’re in luck, then! Part of the job is knowing what would look good on who, and I can't really {i}know{/i} that without trying stuff on myself.
lines.zh: : 那你运气不错！这份工作的一部分就是知道什么衣服穿在谁身上好看，而我不自己试穿，就没法真的{i}知道{/i}。

lines.en: : Again, not a fashion icon, but I don't really think that's true.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，我可不是什么时尚达人，但我觉得这话不成立。

lines.en: : Well, I won't tell anyone you're here to watch me try on clothes if {i}you{/i} don't tell anyone that it's a perk I've been taking advantage of.
lines.zh: : 那这样吧，我{i}不{/i}告诉别人你在这儿看我试衣服，你也别告诉别人这是我一直在利用的职场福利。

lines.en: scene mallfive4
: Just kinda wish dresses looked a little better on me.
lines.zh: : 只是有点希望连衣裙穿在我身上能好看一点。

lines.en: : Really? Why is that?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？为什么？

lines.en: scene mallfive7
: Mmm...Idunno. I guess they just don’t really fit my style?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我也不知道。大概就是不太符合我的风格吧？

lines.en: : All the clothes I wear are pretty flashy, so trying on cutesy stuff just makes me feel like a loser.
lines.zh: : 我穿的衣服都很花哨，所以试穿那种可爱的东西会让我觉得自己像个失败者。

lines.en: : I’m sure you don’t look like a {i}loser.{/i} I can't really see anything not working on you, if you want my opinion.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你看起来一点也不{i}像失败者{/i}。你要是问我的意见，我觉得没有什么是你撑不起来的。

lines.en: : In fact, I'm going to seize this opportunity and say that you should model a dress for me before anything else.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我要抓住这个机会说，你应该先给我模特一条连衣裙看看。

lines.en: scene mallfive10
: How come we've gotta start on hard mode?! What about, like...a tank top or something?
lines.zh: : 为什么一上来就是困难模式啊？！比如……先来件背心之类的？

lines.en: : We've got a whole lingerie section too, you know. Which isn't me implying that I'd model any of it for you. But at this point I'm just trying to steer the conversation away from the dress thing and-
lines.zh: : 我们还有一整片内衣区呢。我可不是在暗示我会穿那些给你看。只是我现在想把话题从连衣裙这件事上引开，然后-

lines.en: : If lingerie is off the table, I'm going to stick to the dress suggestion.
lines.zh: : 如果内衣不在考虑范围内，那我就坚持连衣裙这个提议。

lines.en: scene mallfive7
: I mean...I wouldn't say it's off the table {i}forever...{/i}just...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我也没说它{i}永远{/i}不在考虑范围内……只是……

lines.en: : Oh my God. What am I even saying right now? I'm sorry, Sensei. I just-
lines.zh: : 天哪。我到底在说什么啊？对不起，Sensei。我只是-

lines.en: : There's no need to apologize. {i}Other{/i} teachers might get weirded out by the idea of a student offering to one day model underwear for them, but not me.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉。{i}别的{/i}老师可能会觉得学生主动提出哪天穿内衣给他们看很怪，但我不会。

lines.en: : Which sounds a lot worse when I say it out loud, but I can guarantee it's-
lines.zh: : 说出来听着更糟，但我可以保证-

lines.en: : Uhh...would you maybe...mind keeping your voice down a little? I don't really have a problem with what we're talking about, but I don't want you to, like...get in trouble or anything.
lines.zh: : 呃……你能不能……稍微小声一点？我们聊什么我没意见，但我不想你……惹上麻烦什么的。

lines.en: I quickly look around to make sure no one's been paying attention to the conversation and confirm that we at least {i}appear{/i} to have gone unnoticed just now.
lines.zh: 我迅速环顾四周，确认没人在听我们说话，至少{i}看起来{/i}刚才没被注意到。

lines.en: : I think we're fine. But yeah, that's probably not something we should talk about.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没事。不过也对，这种事我们大概不该聊。

lines.en: : Even if it was a completely normal conversation between two people without any ulterior motives whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 哪怕这完全是两个没有任何别有用心的人之间的普通对话。

lines.en: scene mallfive6
: See, this is why I like you! You’re so chill about everything and like, never make me feel uncomfortable even when we're talking about uncomfortable stuff.
lines.zh: : 看，这就是我喜欢你的原因！你对什么事都很淡定，就算聊到让人不自在的东西，也从来不会让我觉得不自在。

lines.en: : It's kind of like you’re my...big brother or something.
lines.zh: : 感觉有点像你是我……哥哥之类的。

lines.en: : You would model lingerie for your big brother?
lines.zh: : 你会给哥哥当内衣模特？

lines.en: scene mallfive10
: Well, I-
lines.zh: : 嗯，我-

lines.en: : Uhh...
: No! Of course not!
lines.zh: : 不会！当然不会！

lines.en: : Also, I thought we were moving on!
lines.zh: : 还有，我以为我们已经换话题了！

lines.en: : I'm sorry if this bursts your bubble, Chika, but I don't really see you as a little sister.
lines.zh: : 抱歉要打破你的幻想，Chika，但我真没把你当妹妹看。

lines.en: scene mallfive5
: Well...what {i}do{/i} you see me as, Sensei? Just out of curiosity.
lines.zh: : 那……你{i}把{/i}我当成什么，Sensei？只是好奇。

lines.en: : I’ve never had a teacher come visit me at work before. And it’s not like I really view you as {i}just{/i} a teacher either, so...
lines.zh: : 从来没有老师来上班的地方看过我。而且我也没有{i}只{/i}把你当老师看，所以……

lines.en: : I view you as Chika.
lines.zh: : 我把你当成 Chika。

lines.en: scene mallfive4
: That feels...weirdly embarrassing to hear for some reason...
lines.zh: : 这话听着……不知道为什么怪让人不好意思的……

lines.en: scene mallfive6
: Like, I’m glad you see me as me and not just some...flirty bimbo who’s always breaking dress code and stuff.
lines.zh: : 就是……我很高兴你看到的是我本人，而不只是个……总爱卖弄风骚、老违反着装规定的花瓶。

lines.en: : It would be kind of hard to view you as a {i}flirty bimbo{/i} since you recently confirmed to me that you’ve never done anything with a boy before.
lines.zh: : 既然你最近才跟我确认过你从来没跟男生做过什么，那要把你当成{i}那样的花瓶{/i}还挺难的。

lines.en: scene mallfive10
: Well, that's not because I’m {i}against{/i} it! I just...haven't met the right person yet! Nobody's really interested me or whatever!
lines.zh: : 那又不是因为{i}反对{/i}！我只是……还没遇到对的人！没有人真的让我感兴趣什么的！

lines.en: : Plus, I’m super busy all the time and like, no one’s schedule would ever match up with mine.
lines.zh: : 而且我总是特别忙，谁的时间表都跟我对不上。

lines.en: : You think so? Because my schedule seems to match up pretty nicely. We even see each other during[school] days.
lines.zh: : 你这么觉得吗？我的时间表好像跟你挺合得来的。我们[school] 日都能见面。

lines.en: scene mallfive3
: Yeah, but it’s not like I can have my teacher as a boyfriend, right? Isn’t that like, totally against the rules?
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，可我总不能让老师当男朋友吧？那不是完全违反规定吗？

lines.en: : Since when do you care about rules?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候开始在意规定了？

lines.en: scene mallfive6
: Ooooh, good point. So what, then? You wanna go out, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，说得也是。那怎么办？你想跟我交往吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Would you be able to keep it a secret?
lines.zh: : 你能保密吗？

lines.en: scene mallfive10
: Wait, we're still joking, right? I wasn’t...really being serious, but you look super serious right now and it's making me unsure of how to answer.
lines.zh: : 等等，我们还在开玩笑对吧？我刚才……不是认真的，但你现在看起来特别认真，我都不知道该怎么回答了。

lines.en: I guess I should probably wait a {i}little{/i} longer before I go down that path with Chika.
lines.zh: 我大概该再多等{i}一会儿{/i}，再跟 Chika 走那条路。

lines.en: I keep forgetting how innocent she is despite her subconscious desire to flirt with me every second of the day.
lines.zh: 我总是忘了，尽管她潜意识里无时无刻不想跟我调情，她其实有多单纯。

lines.en: I can definitely feel the two of us getting closer quickly, so I'm sure {i}more{/i} is bound to happen eventually, but...
lines.zh: 我确实能感觉到我们俩在迅速靠近，所以{i}更进一步{/i}的事迟早会发生，不过……

lines.en: : Let's take a rain check on dating. I need to at least see you in lingerie before I make my final decision.
lines.zh: : 约会的事先记在账上吧。我至少得先看你穿一次内衣，才能做最终决定。

lines.en: scene mallfive9
: Heheh...sounds good to me.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……听起来不错。

lines.en: : I guess all we can really do is hope you’re not disappointed whenever that time finally comes...
lines.zh: : 我想我们能做的，也就只有祈祷到了那一天你不会失望……

lines.en: scene black
Chika and I hang out for a little while longer before a few customers walk in and she needs to focus on them.
lines.zh: Chika 和我又待了一会儿，随后进来几位客人，她得专心招呼他们。

lines.en: I decide it’s time to head back and we say our goodbyes to one another.
lines.zh: 我觉得该回去了，我们互相道了别。

lines.en: Having no other reason to stay at the mall, I board a bus back to the main part of the city and attempt to figure out what to do with the rest of my day...
lines.zh: 既然没有别的理由继续待在商场，我搭上巴士回到市区主街，开始琢磨今天剩下的时间要干什么……

lines.en: $ mall5 = True
$ chika_love += 1
{i}Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
